_comment: The vitals flow: Readings (blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, blood sugar, measurement time) → Save, then a summary. The four readings are custom catalog components written in Dart (lib/catalog/<input>/, one folder per input: BloodPressureInput, HeartRateInput, TemperatureInput, BloodSugarInput); titles, the measurement time and the button are built-in components here. Each reading is bound to the data model, whose defaults are set by the screen's updateDataModel; "{{now}}" is the current local date and time. Routing and placeholders work like ../nutrition/flow.json.
